2026_02_GB_NYJ.headline: Green Bay’s protection test collides with New York’s aggressive edge pressure
2026_02_GB_NYJ.paragraph1: Green Bay arrives in New York trying to stabilize protection after Jordan Love absorbed four sacks in the opener, while the Jets generated steady pressure in their Week 1 win. The Packers are also without defensive tackle Javon Hargrave, though Lukas Van Ness cleared concussion protocol. New York’s defense can dictate the afternoon if it creates long-yardage situations; Green Bay needs cleaner early downs and explosive completions before the Jets’ rush can control the pocket.
2026_02_GB_NYJ.model_rationale: Green Bay’s protection discipline and ability to create explosives before pressure arrives are central, while New York benefits if its front consistently forces the Packers behind schedule.
